milestone: Package 17: pr-description-check shipped; kit at 17 packages, 132 tests

package.name: dsh-pr-description-check
package.decides: PR description: what / why / how-verified, linked issue, breaking change with migration, and whether the checklist was read
package.distinct_rule: the all-unchecked checklist warning — the template was kept but the thinking was not done; a partially checked list is fine, which keeps the rule from punishing honest partial work
package.integration: CLI reads - from stdin, so `gh pr view 42 --json body --jq .body | npx pr-description-check -` works without a temp file

bug_notes: the issue-reference regex dropped its leading \b for the bare #\d+ alternative: # is a non-word character, so ' #101' has no word boundary in front of it and \b# never matched. Same family as the CJK \b finding from #16464 — both caught by their own tests, neither reachable by reading the pattern.
quality_bar: 132 tests across the kit (10 new), audit 17/17 clean, site 18 pages, npm 0.1.0 live
nouns_covered: 17 check nouns — 6 of them shipped in this session's piling phase (commit-msg, dockerfile, env-example, license, incident-report, ops-runbook, pr-description)
